BillHeading.BriefDescription: Designating the blueberry as the state berry.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state berry; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The blueberry is hereby designated as the official berry of the state of Washington.
